d: Gold prices in India have fallen nearly 20% from January’s record highs, prompting major jewellers to delay purchases ahead of Diwali and Dhanteras amid global market pressures and higher import duties. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump signals willingness to work with Democrats if Republicans lose the midterms, as his Iran war policy faces criticism from former allies and voters. Gursshheen Gahllen explains both developments on Vantage on Firstpost.
